jobs.occupation: Senior Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI's global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
-Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
-Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
-Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI's corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
Flexible working hours - including possibilities for remote work.
Global career prospects - work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
Skills development and career growth - Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance
On-site canteen - light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
Company sports & social activities - from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we're about
But we're more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive - if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies - the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Seasonal Chef Opportunities in LEGOLAND® Billund, Denmark (Koch/Köchin)
jobs.description:
Seasonal Chef Opportunities in LEGOLAND® Billund, Denmark

Are you an experienced chef looking for an exciting opportunity in Denmark?

LEGOLAND® Billund is one of Denmark’s most iconic destinations, home to the original LEGOLAND® Park and three unique accommodation facilities: Hotel LEGOLAND®, Castle Hotel LEGOLAND®, and LEGOLAND® Village.

We are currently recruiting chefs for the 2026 high season. Every day, we welcome thousands of holiday guests from around the world as well as conference and business visitors. If you enjoy working in a professional, fast-paced kitchen environment and take pride in delivering high-quality food experiences, we would love to hear from you.

What We Offer

• A unique opportunity to work in one of Denmark’s most popular tourist destinations

• A diverse workplace serving both international leisure guests and conference visitors

• A friendly, supportive, and multicultural team environment

• A fixed work schedule with the possibility of additional hours

• Employment under Danish collective agreements, ensuring fair working conditions and security

• Competitive salary: 29000 DKK -31000 DKK per month, depending on qualifications and experience

• Start date: 1 July 2026, or as soon as possible

• Employment until 30 September 2026, with the possibility of extension

• Assistance with practical arrangements, including accommodation, registration, and settling into life in Denmark

We Are Looking For

• Qualified chefs, or candidates with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a professional kitchen

• Team players who are positive, reliable, and service-oriented

• Individuals who can work independently and take responsibility for their tasks

• Professionals who thrive in a busy, dynamic environment

• Candidates who can communicate in English or Danish

• Applicants who can start no later than 1 July 2026

Work Eligibility

To be eligible for this position, you must have the legal right to work in Denmark. This means you are either:

• A citizen of an EU/EEA country, or

• In possession of a valid Danish residence and work permit

Interested?

Please send us your CV as soon as possible.

For questions about the position, please contact Niels Switzer, Senoir head chef på

niels.switzer@legoland.dk.

If you have any general questions about your stay, please contact People Partner, Marie-Louise

Bredvig, at llb-hrsupport@legoland.dk

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and positions will be filled as soon as we find the right

candidates.

Join us for an exciting summer season in Denmark and become part of a team that creates

memorable experiences for guests from all over the world.

jobs.occupation: Finance Assistant, Nørresundby, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you our newest team member as a Finance assistant, ready to deepen your expertise and make an impact within a dynamic and supportive finance team? DESMI is an innovative and global company where your ideas matter. We are building a culture that values collaboration, continuous learning and making a difference. If you're looking for a workplace where you can grow, contribute, and be inspired, DESMI is the place for you.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:

• Detail-oriented and structured
• Curious and proactive in improving processes
• Comfortable communicating with both internal and external stakeholder.

A glimpse into the role
As a Finance assistant, you’ll be a key contributor to ensuring accurate and efficient processes across DESMI’s Danish entities and several European subsidiaries. Your role is central in maintaining high data quality, securing timely payments, and supporting internal stakeholders with relevant financial information.

Your role mainly revolves around:

• Administration of customer master data and ensuring accuracy across systems
• Risk assessment and credit insurance for customers
• Written and verbal dunning activities toward customers
• Order release and coordination of collection processes, including handling cases with external debt collection partners
• Close dialogue with Sales and Service to ensure alignment and smooth processes

Your next opportunity starts here

We also imagine that you:

• Have experience working with mid/large companies within credit assessment, accounts receivable or similar fields, preferable in an international company
• Hold an education within finance, office administration, accounting, or have equivalent practical experience
• Are comfortable working in Excel and have basic familiarity with Word and Outlook
• Preferably have experience with Microsoft Dynamics D365FO (not required but an advantage)
• Communicate confidently in English due to frequent international contact
• Ideally also understand German (not required)

The perks of being at DESMI
At DESMI, we want you to feel supported, valued and motivated. That’s why we offer a range of benefits that make a difference – from flexibility and career opportunities to security.

• Flexible working hours and good work–life balance
• A collaborative work culture with room for humor, openness and shared solutions
• Opportunities for professional and personal development
• Global career perspectives as part of an international organization
• Access to canteen, sports activities and social events

jobs.occupation: Part-time Veterinary Nurse
jobs.description:
Veterinary Nurse (Part-Time) - MyPeterinarian, Copenhagen

Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

• 
Tuesday and Wednesday: 09:00-15:00

• 
Monday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00-13:00

• 
Exact schedule to be agreed with the successful candidate

This is a weekday-only position, with no evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

• 
Independently monitoring anaesthesia, including induction and recovery

• 
Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

• 
Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

• 
Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

• 
Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

• 
Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

• 
Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

• 
Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

• 
Has proven experience of independently monitoring anaesthesia

• 
Is comfortable working independently during surgical procedures

• 
Has excellent patient handling skills and a calm, professional approach

• 
Has a good standard of spoken and written English (Danish is an advantage but not essential)

• 
Enjoys being part of a small, collaborative team

What We Offer

• 
A friendly and professional team environment

• 
A varied clinical role with genuine responsibility

• 
No evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard 

• 
Salary: 200dkk/hr

• 
Regular team gatherings and a supportive workplace culture

• 
Opportunity to increase working hours over time, by mutual agreement

• 
Staff discounts on MyPeterinarian veterinary, grooming and pet-sitting services for your own pets

Application Process

Application deadline: 15 August 2026

To apply, please send your CV to: jobs@mypeterinarian.com

Please note that applicants must already have the right to work in Denmark. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

If you have any questions, please contact us at: hej@mypeterinarian.com

By submitting your application, you consent to MyPeterinarian processing your personal data for the purpose of recruitment. Your information will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.

jobs.occupation: Start Your International Career as a Gourmet Butcher – Earn a Salary Throughout Your Apprenticeship - Greater Copenhagen, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you a young EU citizen dreaming of a career in food craftsmanship?

This apprenticeship is open to EU citizens who have the right to live and work in Denmark.

At Born & Kolstrup in Rødovre, Denmark, you will receive a paid apprenticeship, an internationally recognised vocational qualification, and the opportunity to become part of one of Denmark's strongest butcher teams. We are proud winners of the Danish Butcher Award 2025 and are looking for a motivated apprentice who wants to develop in a profession built on quality, craftsmanship and teamwork – in a workplace with an informal management style, employee involvement and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

Read more about the award:
https://goderaavarer.dk/aktuelt/nyheder/2025/se-hvem-der-vandt-slagterprisen-2025/
What does a Gourmet Butcher do?
A Danish Gourmet Butcher does not slaughter animals. Instead, the profession focuses on preparing, cutting and refining high-quality meat products and delicacies.
During your apprenticeship, you will learn to:

• Cut and prepare premium meat products.
• Produce charcuterie, delicacies, convenience foods and ready meals.
• Develop new recipes and food products.
• Work with food safety and quality control.
• Plan production and work closely with experienced colleagues.
After completing your apprenticeship, you will receive a Danish Journeyman's Certificate, a respected vocational qualification recognised both in Denmark and internationally.
What can you expect from your apprenticeship?
We offer:

• A paid apprenticeship throughout your education.
• A thorough introduction and structured training programme.
• Assistance with finding accommodation, obtaining a CPR number and settling into life in Denmark.
• A safe workplace with a strong focus on employee well-being.
• Friendly and experienced colleagues who will support you from day one.
• An informal working environment with employee involvement.
• Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
• A healthy work-life balance with time for friends and leisure activities.
Several of our employees have worked abroad themselves and understand what it is like to start a new life in another country.
We are looking for someone who:

• Is an EU citizen with the right to live and work in Denmark.
• Has a passion for food, quality and craftsmanship.
• Is ambitious and eager to become highly skilled.
• Has completed compulsory education or an equivalent qualification.
• Can communicate in English.
• Is willing to learn Danish and become part of Danish culture.
• Enjoys teamwork and takes responsibility.
Salary and employment conditions

jobs.occupation: Til vores værksteds- og lagerteam i Hasselager søger vi en der tager fat og kan svejse rustfri/ We're looking for someone to join our workshop and warehouse team in Hasselager - someone who's a go do'er and can weld stainless steel
jobs.description:
English Below.

Hos Alfotech hjælper vi hinanden. Det er ikke bare noget vi siger, det er måden vi arbejder på. Hvis du er typen der ser hvad der skal gøres og gør det uden at blive spurgt, så læs videre.

Hvem er vi

Alfotech er videnscenter for procesindustrien. Vi leverer slanger, fittings, koblinger og specialløsninger til fødevare, pharma og den kemiske industri i hele Europa. Vi har travlt, vi leverer hurtigt, og kvaliteten må ikke svigte.

Hvad du skal lave

Dit primære hjem er værkstedet og lageret under vores teamleder Peter. Du svejser i rustfrit stål når der er ordrer på det, og du er med til at samle, montere, trykprøve og klargøre løsninger fra start til slut. Du dokumenterer i vores ERP-system og svejselog.

Og så er der perioderne imellem. Her hjælper du til i pluk, modtagelse og klargøring af varer, eller der hvor holdet har brug for dig. Det er en fast del af jobbet, ikke en undtagelse.

Hvem vi leder efter

Du har erfaring med TIG-svejsning i rustfrit stål, måske som uddannet rustfri smed eller med baggrund fra et værksted hvor rustfrit var hverdagen. Det er udgangspunktet, resten lærer vi dig. Du er i fysisk god form, møder stabilt op og har en naturlig trang til at bidrage. Du er ligeglad med om opgaven den dag hedder svejsning eller varemodtagelse. Truckkort er en fordel, ellers sørger vi for det.

Arbejdstid og ansættelse

Arbejdstiden er 7 til 15, fredag kl. 14:30. Du bliver funktionæransat med fast løn. Skal du gå tidligere en dag, finder vi en løsning og du indhenter timerne.

Vi tilbyder faglig udvikling og betaler for kurser og certifikater. Fælles morgenmad hver fredag og et hold med uformel omgangstone.

English:

At Alfotech, we help each other. It’s not just something we say—it’s the way we work. If you’re the kind of person who sees what needs to be done and does it without being asked, then read on.

Who We Are

Alfotech is a knowledge center for the process industry. We supply hoses, fittings, couplings, and custom solutions to the food, pharmaceutical, and chemical industries throughout Europe. We’re busy, we deliver quickly, and quality must never be compromised.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your primary workstation will be the workshop and warehouse under the supervision of our team leader, Peter. You’ll weld stainless steel when orders come in, and you’ll help assemble, install, pressure-test, and prepare solutions from start to finish. You’ll document your work in our ERP system and welding log.

And then there are the periods in between. During these times, you’ll help with picking, receiving, and preparing goods—or wherever the team needs you. This is an integral part of the job, not an exception.

Who We’re Looking For

You have experience with TIG welding of stainless steel—perhaps as a trained stainless steel welder or with a background in a workshop where working with stainless steel was part of your daily routine. That’s the starting point; we’ll teach you the rest. You’re in good physical shape, show up consistently, and have a natural desire to contribute. You don’t mind whether the task for the day is welding or receiving goods. A forklift license is a plus; if you don’t have one, we’ll take care of it.

Work Hours and Employment

Work hours are 7 a.m. to 3 p.m., with Friday ending at 2:30 p.m. You’ll be hired as a salaried employee with a fixed salary. If you need to leave early one day, we’ll find a solution, and you’ll make up the hours.
